name: Vientiane
tagline: Laid-back Mekong capital of golden stupas
summary: Vientiane is Southeast Asia's most relaxed capital, with French boulevards, golden temples and sunsets over the Mekong. See the gilded Pha That Luang, climb Patuxai, learn about unexploded bombs at COPE, wander the eccentric Buddha Park and eat laap at the riverside night market.
seasonNote: November to February is dry and cooler; the rainy season runs May to October.
arrival: Wattay International is 15 minutes from the centre; the high-speed train links Luang Prabang and China.
cashTip: Carry kip in small notes; US dollars and Thai baht are sometimes accepted. ATMs have low limits.
foodTip: Laap, khao piak sen and baguette sandwiches.

connections.note: Or the sleeper train via Nong Khai.
